event_summary: Two drones targeted the commercial port; one struck worker accommodation and debris from the second landed near fuel tanks.
port_operational_impact: Localized impact; port security response activated
cause_attribution: Attributed in reporting to Iranian strike activity
notes_intelligence_relevance: Direct attack on a commercial port; important benchmark for port resilience and fuel-storage exposure.

event_summary: Smoke and fire were reported from the Zayed Port area following Iranian retaliatory strikes.
port_operational_impact: Operational disruption reported in wider UAE port response
cause_attribution: Iranian attack context
investigation_status: Confirmed visual reporting; detailed damage not fully public
notes_intelligence_relevance: Shows conflict spillover directly into urban port infrastructure.

event_summary: Missile or drone debris sparked a fire at Jebel Ali Port; smoke was visible over the terminal area.
port_operational_impact: DP World paused activities temporarily during the immediate response
cause_attribution: Debris from intercepted incoming threat
notes_intelligence_relevance: Major global transshipment hub; short disruption has regional supply-chain significance.

event_summary: Debris from an intercepted drone caused a fire at Fujairah; one person was lightly injured and some oil-loading operations were suspended.
port_operational_impact: Some oil-loading operations suspended; loadings resumed the next day
cause_attribution: Incoming Iranian drone intercepted; debris impact
notes_intelligence_relevance: Critical because Fujairah sits outside Hormuz and functions as an energy bypass hub.

event_summary: Two drones targeted Salalah Port, injuring one worker and damaging a container crane.
port_operational_impact: Port evacuated and operations temporarily suspended; roughly 48-hour estimate reported
cause_attribution: Likely Iranian strike; local authorities confirmed drone impact
notes_intelligence_relevance: Notable because it extends conflict risk to a major Indian Ocean transshipment port outside Hormuz.

event_summary: A drone hit a gas vessel at Damietta and fire spread to a second gas vessel.
port_operational_impact: Emergency response; energy-import infrastructure disrupted / assessed
cause_attribution: Drone strike confirmed by Egyptian cabinet; attacker unclaimed
notes_intelligence_relevance: Direct attack on LNG/FSRU infrastructure broadens port conflict risk beyond Gulf ports.

event_summary: Russian strikes damaged port export infrastructure in the Odesa region and contributed to disruption of export routes.
port_operational_impact: Export facilities damaged; wider seaport operations heavily constrained
cause_attribution: Russian drone/missile attacks
investigation_status: Confirmed by Ukrainian officials; conflict ongoing
notes_intelligence_relevance: Important for grain, Danube rerouting and Black Sea maritime-risk assessment.

port_location: Port of Izmail / Odesa maritime corridor
incident_sub_type: Drone strike on port and vessels
vessel_asset: Two foreign civilian vessels / port logistics
event_summary: Russian drones hit Izmail port, damaging port infrastructure and foreign civilian vessels including a Panama-flagged vessel.
port_operational_impact: Port operations reportedly remained stable despite damage
cause_attribution: Russian drone attack
notes_intelligence_relevance: Illustrates direct merchant-vessel exposure inside a functioning wartime export port.

event_summary: Explosion at a petroleum product storage facility during maintenance killed one and injured six.
port_operational_impact: Localized facility impact; major port systems remained operational
cause_attribution: Maintenance-related incident; sabotage not indicated initially
notes_intelligence_relevance: Demonstrates maintenance and hazardous-storage risk inside a major energy port.

vessel_asset: Wind Orca; BG Orange; 750-tonne gantry crane
event_summary: Wind Orca collided with berthed container ship BG Orange and then a quayside crane, causing the crane to collapse.
port_operational_impact: Recovery zone established; local operational disruption and cleanup
cause_attribution: Under investigation by police, MAIB and harbour authority
notes_intelligence_relevance: Strong combined case: collision + crane loss + cargo/environmental release + operational disruption.

event_summary: During a heavy-lift operation, a mobile crane overturned toward the vessel and a fire broke out.
port_operational_impact: Berth area secured; investigation and crane recovery required
cause_attribution: Load shift / lifting imbalance reported; formal cause under investigation
notes_intelligence_relevance: Useful port-safety case for heavy-lift procedures, crane stability and berth exclusion zones.

event_summary: A crane fell into the Cooper River near Pier G, creating a submerged navigation hazard.
pollution_environmental_impact: Potential fuel pollution controlled with boom
port_operational_impact: 100-yard safety zone; shipping later resumed around hazard
cause_attribution: Cause not stated publicly in Coast Guard release
investigation_status: Salvage completed 30 Jul; safety zone rescinded
notes_intelligence_relevance: Demonstrates how shoreside equipment failure can become a channel/navigation incident.

event_summary: Outbound SEA HONOR collided with inbound BLACK RHINO near buoy 20; BLACK RHINO was intentionally grounded after damage.
port_operational_impact: Navigation channel temporarily obstructed then reopened
cause_attribution: Preliminary indication of steering-control loss aboard BLACK RHINO
notes_intelligence_relevance: Direct example of channel blockage risk and emergency grounding to restore access.

event_summary: Containership MAERSK VALPARAISO contacted tanker LADY MARTINA during manoeuvring; both vessels subsequently grounded.
port_operational_impact: Channel/berthing disruption and emergency response
cause_attribution: Under investigation
notes_intelligence_relevance: Combines container-port access, collision, injury, grounding and pollution exposure.

operator_authority: Syama Prasad Mookerjee Port / vessel interests
event_summary: Container vessel lost control while navigating the Hooghly, struck the riverbank and grounded.
port_operational_impact: Temporary vessel immobilization; refloated at high tide with tug assistance
cause_attribution: Possible steering gear problem plus strong tidal conditions
notes_intelligence_relevance: Good access-channel case for pilotage, steering reliability and tidal constraints.

operator_authority: USCG / NTSB / Woods Hole Oceanographic Institution
event_summary: Research vessel Atlantis grounded in Great Harbor Channel at the entrance to Woods Hole and freed itself after about 12 minutes.
port_operational_impact: Short-lived channel casualty; vessel moored after refloating
cause_attribution: Cause under investigation
investigation_status: USCG lead; NTSB major marine casualty investigation ongoing
notes_intelligence_relevance: Includes quantified damage estimate and formal U.S. major marine casualty status.

operator_authority: Indonesian authorities / MPA Singapore / Samudera Shipping
event_summary: Container vessel took on water and sank about 6 km off Batam; all nine crew were rescued.
pollution_environmental_impact: No oil pollution reported; potential drifting-container hazard
port_operational_impact: Straits traffic unaffected; navigational warnings issued
cause_attribution: Water ingress; detailed cause not public
notes_intelligence_relevance: Relevant to Singapore/Batam approaches and secondary hazards from floating containers.

port_location: South of Aleutian Islands / Long Beach-bound
event_summary: OOCL Sunflower lost dozens of containers overboard while en route to Long Beach; USCG prepared for vessel arrival and cargo assessment.
pollution_environmental_impact: Potential floating-container hazard; no discharge observed
port_operational_impact: Long Beach authorities prepared for arrival inspection; no port closure
cause_attribution: Heavy-weather/cargo-loss circumstances under review
notes_intelligence_relevance: Although offshore, this is directly relevant to container-loss tracking and destination-port response.

event_summary: Panama-flagged cargo ship Ocean Winner sank off eastern India while carrying iron ore; search and rescue operations followed.
port_operational_impact: No direct port closure reported; casualty affected regional voyage
cause_attribution: Cause unknown at initial reporting
notes_intelligence_relevance: Port-linked bulk-shipping casualty; useful for route-level risk even though not inside harbour limits.

event_summary: CMA CGM PETRA suffered a cargo-hold fire in the Strait of Malacca; salvors were engaged and the ship remained off Penang.
port_operational_impact: Missed scheduled port call; salvage operations ongoing
cause_attribution: Cause not public
notes_intelligence_relevance: Relevant to Malacca/port-call disruption and salvage capacity.

event_summary: Ro-ro passenger ferry contacted a jetty at Holyhead, puncturing the hull and causing engine-room flooding.
port_operational_impact: Port-side vessel casualty; detailed disruption assessed by MAIB
cause_attribution: Under MAIB assessment
notes_intelligence_relevance: Early-2026 port allision; useful benchmark for berth-contact and flooding risk.

event_summary: A worker aboard M/V Bruce died after being struck by a large metal beam while the vessel was in Mackay Harbour.
port_operational_impact: Localized investigation; no broad port shutdown reported
cause_attribution: Industrial accident under investigation
notes_intelligence_relevance: Captures occupational safety as a distinct port-incident category.
